whenToUse: Fixed height lists and photo columns that scroll inside their own box with a custom scrollbar
Sideways strips of cards or photos kept to the width of their container
Wide tables that pan on both axes without widening the page around them

whenNotToUse.when: Section links that light up as the reader scrolls past each heading
A chat transcript that opens on the newest turn and follows streamed replies
Shoppers weighing rival products on price, star rating and specs

agentNotes: Give the `ScrollArea` root a bounded height or width through `className`, or it grows with its content and never scrolls
`ScrollArea` draws only the vertical `ScrollBar`; for sideways scrolling pass a `ScrollBar` with `orientation` horizontal as a child
